title: Validate installed skill roots, not just source skill assets
description: Dabble kept stale installed Boreal skills even after the source skill contract was fixed. In boreal-work, doctor skills validates the source assets, but there is no installed-root validation mode for .agents/skills or .claude/skills. Add installed-skill validation so consumers can detect stale or incomplete adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk doctor skills can validate a configured or explicit install root for Codex and Claude targets.
The check detects installed SKILL.md content that differs from source, missing boreal.yaml, unexpected agents/openai.yaml in Claude installs, and missing workflow resolver guidance.
Project setup or install docs tell agents which command validates installed skills after bwrk install.
closedReason: Installed skill root validation is implemented, documented, and tested.
